name: @tpmjs/tools-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare API tools for AI agents. Manage DNS records, zones, Workers, KV namespaces, and purge cache.

tools.name: listZones
tools.description: List Cloudflare zones with optional name and status filtering.

tools.name: getZone
tools.description: Get details of a specific Cloudflare zone by ID.

tools.name: purgeCache
tools.description: Purge cached content from a Cloudflare zone by URLs or purge everything.

tools.name: listDnsRecords
tools.description: List DNS records for a Cloudflare zone with type and name filters.

tools.name: createDnsRecord
tools.description: Create a new DNS record in a Cloudflare zone.

tools.name: updateDnsRecord
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record in a Cloudflare zone.

tools.name: deleteDnsRecord
tools.description: Delete a DNS record from a Cloudflare zone.

tools.name: listWorkers
tools.description: List all Workers scripts in your Cloudflare account.

tools.name: getWorker
tools.description: Get metadata and bindings for a specific Worker script.

tools.name: deleteWorker
tools.description: Delete a Worker script from your Cloudflare account.

tools.name: listKvNamespaces
tools.description: List KV namespaces in your Cloudflare account.

tools.name: listKvKeys
tools.description: List keys in a Cloudflare KV namespace with optional prefix filter.

tools.name: getKvValue
tools.description: Get the value of a key from a Cloudflare KV namespace.

tools.name: putKvValue
tools.description: Write a key-value pair to a Cloudflare KV namespace.

tools.name: deleteKvKey
tools.description: Delete a key from a Cloudflare KV namespace.
